task_scoping.cross_task_leakage_prevention: Rejects keys pointing outside task database directory fail closed

question_closure_grounding.rule: Question transition to answered requires disposition and basis_refs; without basis refs, rejected with QUESTION_CLOSURE_BASIS_REQUIRED

epistemic_boundary.rule: Hypotheses remain hypotheses; they do not promote to findings without verified evidence backing

analyst_acceptance.rule: Agent cycle execution never marks secondary analyses as accepted

report_admission.rule: Agent cycle execution never admits findings into report_evidence

report_publication.rule: Agent cycle execution never creates or publishes forensic_reports
